submissions.decision-reconcile-translated-menu-edits: SELECT entry_code, CASE WHEN local_label COLLATE BINARY IS NOT base_label THEN 'review' WHEN incoming_label IS NULL THEN 'remove' ELSE 'write' END AS action_code, CASE WHEN local_label COLLATE BINARY IS base_label THEN incoming_label END AS payload FROM menu_edits WHERE incoming_label COLLATE BINARY IS NOT local_label AND incoming_label COLLATE BINARY IS NOT base_label ORDER BY entry_code COLLATE BINARY ASC
submissions.decision-recoup-returns-against-originat: WITH per_lot AS (SELECT l.lot_id, l.imprint_id, l.unit_cents, MIN(l.issued_qty, COALESCE(SUM(p.request_qty), 0)) - MIN(l.issued_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posted_day < '2026-04-01' THEN p.request_qty ELSE 0 END)) AS recognized FROM credit_lots AS l LEFT JOIN return_posts AS p ON p.lot_id = l.lot_id AND p.posted_day < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY l.lot_id, l.imprint_id, l.issued_qty, l.unit_cents) SELECT imprint_id, SUM(recognized) AS returned_credits, SUM(recognized * unit_cents) AS debit_cents FROM per_lot GROUP BY imprint_id ORDER BY imprint_id ASC
submissions.decision-recover-archived-catalogue-join: WITH RECURSIVE edges(src, dst) AS (SELECT from_code, to_code FROM substitution UNION SELECT to_code, from_code FROM substitution), walk(entry_id, printed_code, code, previous_code, hops) AS (SELECT s.entry_id, s.printed_code, s.printed_code, NULL, 0 FROM shelf_entry AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM master_item AS m WHERE m.master_code = s.printed_code) UNION ALL SELECT w.entry_id, w.printed_code, e.dst, w.code, w.hops + 1 FROM walk AS w JOIN edges AS e ON e.src = w.code WHERE e.dst IS NOT w.previous_code) SELECT w.entry_id, w.printed_code, m.master_code, m.item_label, w.hops FROM walk AS w JOIN master_item AS m ON m.master_code = w.code ORDER BY w.entry_id COLLATE BINARY ASC
submissions.decision-recover-missing-counter-interva: SELECT r.belt_id, r.end_hour, COALESCE(r.interval_items, r.meter_items - p.meter_items) AS item_count FROM belt_readings AS r LEFT JOIN belt_readings AS p ON p.belt_id = r.belt_id AND p.end_hour = r.end_hour - 1 AND p.meter_run = r.meter_run AND p.meter_items <= r.meter_items WHERE r.interval_items IS NOT NULL OR p.meter_items IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.belt_id ASC, r.end_hour ASC
